  • Constructor Details

    • ViewCreateDeleteLessons

      public ViewCreateDeleteLessons()

      Method: ViewCreateDeleteLessonsPage()

      Description: This method initializes all the elements of the graphical user interface. This method determines the location, size, font, color, and change and event handlers for each GUI object.

      This is a singleton, so this is performed just one. Subsequent uses fill in the changeable fields using the displayCreateDeleteLessons method.

  • Method Details

    • displayCreateDeleteLessons

      public static void displayCreateDeleteLessons(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)

      Method: displayCreateDeleteLessons(Stage ps, User user)

      Description: This method is the single entry point from outside this package to cause the CreateDeleteLessons page to be displayed. It first sets up very shared attributes so we don't have to pass parameters. It then checks to see if the page has been setup. If not, it instantiates the class, initializes all the static aspects of the GUI widgets (e.g., location on the page, font, size, and any methods to be performed). After the instantiation, the code then populates the elements that change based on the user and the system's current state. It then sets the Scene onto the stage, and makes it visible to the user.

      Parameters:
      ps - specifies the JavaFX Stage to be used for this GUI and it's methods
      user - specifies the current User
